ADY.note: Air Arabia Abu Dhabi: Air Arabia's scheme, its own small titles.

AHK.note: Air Hong Kong: DHL's Hong Kong airline, A330Fs in DHL paint (B-LDQ titled DHL on Commons, 2025-05-07; B-LDZ at Sydney, 2025-11-17).

AKX.note: ANA Wings: ANA's domestic regional, in ANA paint.

APG.note: Philippines AirAsia: the same red airasia.com scheme, Philippine flag.

ARE.note: LATAM Airlines Colombia (ex-Aires): the LATAM group scheme.

ASH.note: Mesa Airlines: United Express only (E175), now part of Republic Airways Holdings (merger closed 25 Nov 2025) but still flying under its own certificate. Of six E175s photographed 2025-2026, four wear the 2019 scheme (N89304, N85373, N87319, N85369) and two still the 2010 one (N85358, N89349), so UAL/express-2010 should be tagged by airframe.

AWI.note: Air Wisconsin: American Eagle only since 2024 (CRJ200). Replaces the AAL/standard entry in operators.json; no 2025-2026 Commons photo found in 'Current CRJ200 of Air Wisconsin', so not photo-checked.

AWQ.note: Indonesia AirAsia: the same red airasia.com scheme, Indonesian flag.

AXM.note: Malaysia AirAsia: the same red airasia.com scheme as Thai AirAsia, Malaysian flag.

BLX.note: TUI fly Nordic: same TUI scheme, SE- registered 737s.

BOX.note: AeroLogic (Leipzig): 777Fs in DHL paint with small 'AeroLogic' titles by the door (D-AALO on Commons, 2025-08-16).

CFE.note: BA CityFlyer (London City Embraers, A320s from Edinburgh/LCY) flies in British Airways' paint.

CLH.note: Lufthansa CityLine: flies its CRJ900s and Airbuses in Lufthansa's livery with 'Lufthansa' titles. A few CRJs may still carry the pre-2018 scheme until retired.

CNM.note: Air China Inner Mongolia: believed to fly Air China's paint (unchecked).

CSG.note: China Southern Airlines Cargo (FAA JO 7340.2: CSG = CHINA SOUTHERN AIRLINES CARGO, telephony SOUTHERN CARGO): China Southern's 777Fs, now flown under their own code, in China Southern's kapok scheme with cargo titles (B-223N, CSG2569 on adsb.lol 2026-11-20, hexdb owner 'China Southern Cargo', flag CSG; on Commons in that paint 2025-08-02). The 777Fs are tagged 'cargo' in airframes/CSN.json.

DAE.note: DHL Aero Expreso (Panama): DHL's Latin American airline, 757Fs in DHL yellow (HP-1910DAE on Commons at Guatemala City, 2024-08-30).

DHK.note: DHL Air UK: already mapped in operators.json; 777F G-DHMC (2026-03-01) and 767s in DHL paint confirm it.

DHX.note: DHL International Aviation ME (Bahrain): 757/767 freighters in DHL paint (A9C-DHT on Commons, 2026-07-23 and 2026-09-29).

EAI.note: Emerald Airlines, ATR 72-600s as Aer Lingus Regional in the 2019 scheme with 'Aer Lingus Regional' titles; ICAO code unsure, check.

EAQ.note: QantasLink (Eastern Australia Airlines): Qantas paint with 'QantasLink' titles.

EDV.note: Endeavor Air: Delta Connection only (CRJ900). Checked: N933XJ (Jun 2026) carries 'DELTA' / 'CONNECTION' titles.

EFW.note: BA Euroflyer (Gatwick short-haul A320s) flies in British Airways' paint.

ENY.note: Envoy Air: American Eagle only (E175, E170, ERJ145). Checked on Commons: E175s N216NN (Aug 2026), N286NN (Jul 2026), N239NN (Jun 2026), N339HG (Feb 2026) all carry 'American Eagle' titles.

EST.note: Xfly (ex Regional Jet), CRJ900s flying for SAS in SAS paint; ICAO code unsure, check.

EUK.note: Aer Lingus UK, A321neos in the 2019 scheme.

EWL.note: Eurowings Europe (Malta, IATA E6): flies Eurowings' A320-family aircraft (9H- registered) in full Eurowings paint under its own code. Its Austrian predecessor EWE ceased in 2023.

FCM.note: Norra (Nordic Regional Airlines), ATRs and E190s for Finnair in Finnair paint; ICAO code from memory (a sub-agent suggested NRD), check.

GAP.note: PAL Express: Dash 8-400s and ATRs in Philippine Airlines paint.

GJS.note: GoJet: United Express only (CRJ550). Commons photos 2023-2025 (N539GJ, N543GJ, N544GJ) show the 2019 scheme. Caution: the FAA registry (Nov 2026) now lists the GJ-series CRJ550s under SkyWest / SkyWest Leasing, and several are photographed as SkyWest-flown, so GoJet may have little or no flying left in 2026.

GLG.note: Avianca Ecuador (ex-Aerogal): Avianca's paint, Ecuadorian flag.

HOP.note: Air France Hop's regional jets wear Air France's paint (some still with HOP! titles; check).

IBK.note: Norwegian Air International (Ireland AOC), largely wound down; any remaining 737s in Norwegian paint.

JAC.note: Japan Air Commuter: ATRs in JAL's Tsurumaru scheme.

JAF.note: TUI fly Belgium (ex-Jetairfly): same TUI scheme, OO- registered 737s and 787s.

JAP.note: JetSMART Peru: the group's paint, Peruvian flag.

JES.note: JetSMART Argentina: the group's paint, Argentine flag and its own animal on each fin.

JIA.note: PSA Airlines: American Eagle only (CRJ700, CRJ900). Checked: CRJ900s N641NN (Jan 2026), N607NN (Oct 2025), N618NN (Jan 2025) carry 'American Eagle'.

JLJ.note: J-Air: E170/E190s in JAL's Tsurumaru scheme.

JTA.note: Japan Transocean Air: 737-800s in JAL's Tsurumaru scheme.

KII.note: Kalitta Charters II (FAA JO 7340.2: KII = KALITTA CHARTERS II LLC, telephony DRAGSTER): 737-800 converted freighters flown for DHL Express under a CMI deal since 2022 (ch-aviation: N318FL, N325FL), in DHL paint (AirHistory.net files N325FL and N326FL as 'DHL International', N326FL at Cincinnati 2024-09-02: evidence only). N326FL (hexdb: owner DHL Air) flew as KII833 Cedar Rapids-Kansas City, a DHL route, on 2026-11-20. No open photo of a KII 737 found: medium confidence.

LAP.note: LATAM Airlines Paraguay: the LATAM group scheme.

LCO.note: LATAM Cargo Chile: the LATAM scheme with 'LATAM Cargo' titles on its 767/777 freighters.

LRC.note: Avianca Costa Rica (ex-LACSA): Avianca's paint, Costa Rican flag.

LTG.note: LATAM Cargo Brasil (ex-ABSA): the LATAM scheme with 'LATAM Cargo' titles.

MAC.note: Air Arabia Maroc: Air Arabia's scheme.

MAY.note: Malta Air (Ryanair group, 9H- registrations): runs Ryanair's German bases incl. Berlin; nearly all aircraft in full Ryanair paint (e.g. 9H-VVJ, 2025), a few with small 'Malta Air' titles or the Maltese flag.

NJS.note: National Jet Express (Cobham), flying for QantasLink in its paint.

NTH.note: Hokkaido Air System: JAL's Tsurumaru scheme.

NWK.note: Network Aviation, for QantasLink/Qantas: Qantas paint.

OAL.note: Olympic Air, Aegean's subsidiary; Dash 8s and ATRs in Aegean colors.

OZW.note: Virgin Australia Regional Airlines (ex-Skywest): Virgin Australia paint.

PDT.note: Piedmont Airlines: American Eagle only (ERJ145). No 2025-2026 Commons photo found in 'Current Embraer ERJ 145 of Piedmont Airlines'; the scheme is assumed the same as other Eagle jets (not photo-checked).

PGA.note: Portugália, flying as TAP Express (E190/E195) in TAP's 2017 colors with 'express' in the emblem and on the fin (TAP/express). Its jets mostly fly under TAP's own callsign (TAP), so they're also tagged by registration in airframes/TAP.json (2026-11-25).

QXE.note: Horizon Air: Alaska only (E175; Q400s retired 2023). Its E175s carry 'Alaska' with 'HORIZON' after it (N657QX, Jul 2026), unlike SkyWest's Alaska E175s ('SkyWest'): hence a separate variant, ASA/regional-horizon.

RAC.note: Ryukyu Air Commuter: JAL's Tsurumaru scheme.

RBG.note: Air Arabia Egypt: Air Arabia's scheme.

RLK.note: Air Nelson: Air New Zealand Link Q300s in Air NZ paint.

RUK.note: Ryanair UK (G-RUK.. 737-800s): full Ryanair paint with a small Union flag by the registration.

SHT.note: British Airways Shuttle: the callsign (telephony SHUTTLE) British Airways flies its UK domestic shuttle A320s under from Heathrow, in its own paint (G-EUYD and G-EUUS seen as SHT at Heathrow, Nov 2026).

SLI.note: Aeroméxico Connect: Embraer regional jets in Aeroméxico's paint.

SRQ.note: Cebgo: ATRs in Cebu Pacific paint, some with 'cebgo' titles.

SZS.note: SAS Connect (Ireland AOC), A320neos in the 2019 scheme.

TAI.note: Avianca El Salvador (ex-TACA): Avianca's paint, Salvadoran flag.

TAX.note: Thai AirAsia X: the AirAsia scheme on A330s.

TFL.note: TUI fly Netherlands (ex-Arkefly): same TUI scheme, PH- registered 737s and 787s.

TNO.note: Avianca Cargo México (AeroUnion, rebranded 24 June 2025): its A330-300P2Fs fly Avianca Cargo's paint, N338QT in the green scheme with a small 'Mexico' under 'avianca' (LAX, Commons 2026-03-07); N337QT still red (tagged in airframes/TNO.json).

TUI.note: TUI fly Deutschland: the same TUI wave scheme on 737-800/MAX (D-ATUx, D-AMAx); big at German airports incl. Berlin and Frankfurt.

TVJ.note: Thai Vietjet Air: VietJet's scheme with Thai details.

UCA.note: CommutAir: United Express only (ERJ145). All four ERJ145s photographed in 2025 (N10156, N31131, N11192, N11184) wear the 2019 scheme.

VOC.note: Volaris Costa Rica: Volaris's own scheme, a Costa Rican flag by the registration (N547VL at Guatemala City, Commons 2025-10-02; N548VL at San José, 2026-01-24).

VOS.note: Volaris El Salvador: Volaris's own scheme (pixel tail, 'volaris' titles, magenta engines), a Salvadoran flag by the registration (N549VL at Guatemala City, Commons 2024-08-30).

WHT.note: White Airways' ATR 72s wet-leased to TAP Express in TAP colors.

XAX.note: AirAsia X: the AirAsia scheme on A330s.
